description: Live Testnet deployment, redeployed and verified end-to-end on 2026-09-13. Every id above was read back from the live network after deployment rather than transcribed. Verified live on this contract id: schema_version returns 1; admin returns the configured admin; is_authorized(account, token) answers false (fail-closed) for a token that is not bound to an active policy; register_version, activate_version and bind_token each succeeded against the real ledger and emitted their events (policy_created, rule_registered x4, policy_activated, token_bound). The sibling deployment — safeguard-hooks CC7UKMCY3J7LB2WGU6D3MPRSSK3RKEC6MEXJJKOXRPTZAPRNXKPVPKPN — is wired to this contract id, and its initialize/configure/bind plus freeze/unfreeze administration were exercised live against it. Earlier verification, 2026-09-08: the predecessor deployment (CCOEMBBUNF3WO24YCH637G2TKCFGBN6QMUSUB4ODPLPGF4BUS64WPR47) approved a compliant subject and blocked denylist/sanctions matches; is_authorized approved only verified-active accounts on a bound token and answered false for unverified, frozen, suspended or restricted accounts, unbound tokens and inactive policies; and the real compliance-hooks deployment wired to it passed every enforcement gate. That deployment was rebuilt with the gas-optimized wasm (docs/gas.md) so is_authorized skips redundant token-binding reads and registry lookups for rules the policy does not enable. The admin secret key lives in the SAFEGUARD_ADMIN_SK env var only — never in this file.
